parameters.name: DependentPolicyId
parameters.description:
The ID of the parent policy.
      
(The specific dependency order from low to high is Section -> Requirement -> Standard)

parameters.name: PolicyShowName
parameters.description: The name of the custom policy.

parameters.name: PolicyType
parameters.description:
The policy category type for custom check rules:
- **STANDARD**: Add to a standard.
- **REQUIREMENT**: Add to a requirement.
- **SECTION**: Add to a section.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The name of the major policy category (required when PolicyType is STANDARD):
- **AISPM**: AI Configuration Management (AISPM).
- **IDENTITY_PERMISSION**: Identity and Permission Management (CIEM).
- **RISK**: Security Risk.
- **COMPLIANCE**: Compliance Risk.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas create-check-policy --policy-type STANDARD --policy-show-name TestPolicyName --dependent-policy-id 123 --type AISPM --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas CreateCheckPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --PolicyType STANDARD --Type AISPM --DependentPolicyId 123 --PolicyShowName TestPolicyName
